fields.name: mode
fields.label: Repetition mode
fields.description: Determines how contents are drawn into repetition rounds, based on how well they were answered before.

importantDescription.example:
• Leitner system: Review exercises on expanding intervals, moving correctly answered exercises to higher “boxes” (longer gaps) and sending incorrect ones back to lower boxes (shorter gaps).
  • Fixed-interval: Repeating the same practice set after a constant time delay each session (e.g., every 3 days) regardless of performance.
  • Repeat until mastered: Practice approach where you keep repeating an exercise in successive attempts until you can perform it to a defined mastery level, then you move on.
  • Custom: Exercises by ranking items using time since last attempt, last score and other weighted parameters.

fields.name: general
fields.label: General settings
fields.description: Settings that apply regardless of the chosen repetition mode.

fields.name: pagesPerRound
fields.label: Maximum contents per round
fields.description: Maximum number of contents to include in a repetition round. Leave empty to include all contents that are due.

fields.name: maxRounds
fields.label: Maximum number of rounds
fields.description: Leave empty or set to 0 for an unlimited number of rounds.

fields.name: canGoBackwards
fields.label: User can go backwards
fields.description: If checked, the user can go backwards to a previous question.

fields.name: canSkipForward
fields.label: User can skip forward
fields.description: If checked, the user can skip forward without answering the current question.

fields.name: overrideShowSolutionButton

fields.name: overrideRetryButton

fields.description: This option determines if the "Retry" button will be shown for all questions, hidden for all questions or configured for each question individually.
